project_title: RPP Digital Studio - Indonesian Teacher Document Suite

theme_strategy.theme_description: Clean, official, and soothing academic layout tailored for Indonesian educators under Kurikulum Merdeka & K13 standards. Combines modern teacher SaaS dashboard with realistic A4 paper print workspace.

interactive.button_secondary: bg-white hover:bg-slate-100 border border-slate-300 text-slate-700 transition-all
interactive.button_accent: bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-700 text-white font-medium shadow-md transition-all

key_features_to_build: Authentication (Guru Login/Register & Profile settings with NIP, School Name, Headmaster Name)
Dashboard with statistics (Total RPP, Prota, Prosem, KKTP, LKPD, Posters, Last Edited)
Dual RPP Creation Flow: 1) Multi-step Manual Form 2) AI File Upload (PDF/Scan/Image OCR & Gemini extraction)
Document Generators Suite: Prota, Prosem, KKTP, Alokasi Waktu, ATP, Asesmen Rubrik & Soal, LKPD Interactive Worksheet, Poster Media Pembelajaran Generator
Live Editable Preview Mode (Rich text / structured inputs) before saving
Saved Documents Library (Filter by Mata Pelajaran, Kelas/Fase, Kurikulum, Type with search & tags)
A4 Print Workspace with official Kop Sekolah header, signatures section, page-break print optimization (@media print styling)
instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all components use standard JavaScript file extensions (.js or .jsx) as configured in the repo.
Always include comprehensive `data-testid` attributes on interactive elements (e.g. `data-testid='btn-create-rpp-manual'`, `data-testid='input-pdf-upload'`, `data-testid='btn-print-a4'`).
Implement full support for `@media print` CSS so clicking Print accurately prints clean A4 documents without UI sidebars or buttons.

Provide built-in templates for Kurikulum Merdeka (Modul Ajar / RPP) and K13 formats with standard Indonesian educational terms: Identitas, Capaian Pembelajaran (CP), Alur Tujuan Pembelajaran (ATP), Profil Pelajar Pancasila, Pertanyaan Pemantik, Kegiatan Pembelajaran (Pendahuluan, Inti, Penutup), and Asesmen.
Provide easy quick-demo sample files and pre-loaded templates for teachers so they can generate documents instantly.
Use Lucide-React icons for intuitive navigation (e.g., FileText, Upload, Printer, Sparkles, BookOpen, Calendar, Layers, CheckCircle, Download).

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_ai_slop: Avoid standard dark corporate SaaS defaults. Use warm academic emerald hues and authentic paper sheet styling.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.data_testid_requirement: All interactive elements, buttons, form controls, and saved items MUST include descriptive kebab-case data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_transparent_overlays: Header and dropdown menus must have solid or crisp backdrop-blur backgrounds with borders, never raw transparent.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.print_readiness: Every document view must look like an official A4 document with crisp margins, school letterhead (Kop Sekolah), and signature blocks.
